path_step: Teacher cancels course deletion from the 'Modify Course' modal.
test_scenario: Verify that a teacher can cancel the course deletion process from the modify course modal, ensuring the course remains intact.
test_case_title: Verify Teacher can cancel course deletion before final confirmation
pre_condition: Teacher is logged in and has created a course. The 'Modify Course' modal for an existing course is open.
expected_result: The 'Modify Course' modal closes, and the course remains listed on the Dashboard.
post_condition: Course exists and is visible on the Dashboard. Teacher remains logged in.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Edit Course' button next to an existing course to open the 'Modify Course' modal.
Click the 'Cancel Button' within the 'Modify Course' modal.
Verify that the 'Modify Course' modal closes.
Verify that the course is still present in the list on the Dashboard.

uncovered_conditions: User canceling the deletion process from the 'Modify Course' modal.
